description: Replaces .github/dependabot.yml, so one bot owns dependency updates here.
Renovate was already running this repository -- the sbt 2, Scala 2.13.18 and
Spark 4 bumps all came through it -- while Dependabot was configured for the
same two ecosystems. This removes that overlap.
There is no Scala Steward here, so Renovate covers the sbt build itself.

packageRules.description: Was the sbt ecosystem in .github/dependabot.yml: weekly, open-pull-requests-limit 10. Grouped, which Dependabot was not doing -- twelve separate bump PRs were open here at once before.
Was the github-actions ecosystem: weekly, limit 5. Grouped into one PR.
